cards.text: Pull up a stool, friend, because we're hitting the road with Jesus and His disciples. The day of His ascension is getting close. And Jesus sets out for Jerusalem.

cards.question: As the day of His ascension gets close, Jesus ___ sets out for Jerusalem.

cards.text: Jesus sends messengers on ahead into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him. It's calling ahead so the room's ready when you pull in. Smart.

cards.question: Jesus' messengers reach the Samaritan village. How do the people there respond to Him?
Why does the Samaritan village refuse to welcome Jesus?

answers.text: They had never heard of Him

cards.text: James and John, two of Jesus' disciples, see all this. And they come to Jesus with an offer that is, uh… a LOT.

cards.question: James and John ask, “Lord, do You want us to call down ___ from heaven to consume them?”
True or false: Jesus tells James and John to go ahead and call it down on the Samaritan village.

cards.text: Then Jesus and His disciples just go on to another village. Friend, if somebody doesn't hold the elevator for me, I'm still practicing my speech about it in the shower that NIGHT.
As they're walking along the road, someone says to Jesus, “I will follow You wherever You go.” WHEREVER. That is a big word, friend.

cards.question: Jesus answers the man who says he'll follow Him wherever: “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.” What is Jesus warning him about?

answers.text: Following Him means no settled home
The road ahead has wild animals
The man needs a house first

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to another man and says, “Follow Me.” The man says, “Lord, first…” and oh, I KNOW that word, friend, every snooze button on earth has heard it a thousand times.

cards.question: Jesus tells a man, “Follow Me.” The man replies, “Lord, first let me go and ___ my father.”

cards.text: But Jesus tells him, “Let the dead bury their own dead.” And then Jesus hands this man a job.

cards.question: Instead of burying his father first, what does Jesus tell this man to go do?

cards.text: Then still another man speaks up: “I will follow You, Lord; but first…” There's that word AGAIN.

cards.question: True or false: This third man asks Jesus to let him first say farewell to his family.

cards.text: Jesus answers him with a picture from the field: a man who puts his hand to the plow.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture, what does the man at the plow do that makes him not fit for the kingdom of God?

cards.text: Then Jesus declares, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.” Friend, I tried driving forward while staring in the rearview mirror once, and I met a hedge. Up close.
